answer: A bond of 18% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in dune, and grove reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 87 aliases, and each one needs its own funded timber account. A farm of 2014 identities would post 3169 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
